rows.Origin:
Bred by G. Kasturi Rangan (India, before 1985).
Introduced in India by KSG Sons/KSG's Roses in 1985 as 'Tungabhadra'.
rows.Bloom: Orange, copper shading, carmine-red highlights. Double (17-25 petals), cluster-flowered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
